data.name: Biomydra
data.detailed_description:
Play as Snow, a solo agent sent on a mission to Biomydra to report on the fate of a fellow officer. Explore colorful environments in this toe curling action-adventure game as you unfurl the staggering truth about the breathing planet you are walking on and the twisted people who sent you there. With the help of her magnetic arm, solve brilliant puzzles and fight your way through daunting enemies to reach your ultimate goal.

A product entirely developed by the students of Campus ADN, class of 2015-2016 during their third trimester as their final project.

reviews.review:
A decent F2P platformer worth a shot.

I'v played the other game made by the students of Le Campus ADN (called Dystopy) and when I compare the two I find this game a lot better constructed. The bad points on that game are pretty much the opposite on this one; Attuning music, No FPS drops, a quick tutorial jumping early into the puzzle elements and the environment has an appealing look. I noticed one bug that kept coming back a few times, not activating certain objects when you press the right button at the first attempts (having to reposition slightly in order to work) but this is a minor issue. Besides that the game is in french, but even so the mechanics are understandable without knowing the language. The biggest con is probably the combat being dull and I pretty much skipped the mobs as much as possible. Luckily the platforming action makes more than up for it.
